FIND-F-001-S1.title: Align Provider Search Schema with Shared Contract
FIND-F-001-S1.description: Align provider search Pydantic models with existing shared schema (FIND-P-M1) to avoid duplication, ensuring inputs (query, location, specialty, filters) and outputs (provider metadata, scores, fallback flags) reuse canonical definitions.

FIND-F-001-S2.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
FIND-F-001-S2.description: Implement provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries, including scoring and ranking, and fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector results are insufficient or below threshold.

FIND-F-001-S3.title: Expose Provider Search via Find Care Facade
FIND-F-001-S3.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, location normalization, and search execution for tool routing and API consumption.

FIND-F-001-S4.title: Extend Shared Test Suite for Provider Search
FIND-F-001-S4.description: Extend existing provider search tests (FIND-P-M1) to cover vector ranking thresholds, taxonomy fallback triggers, and edge cases specific to this implementation without duplicating baseline test coverage.

FIND-F-001-S5.title: Validate Integration with Embeddings and Provider Data
FIND-F-001-S5.description: Validate compatibility with embedding generation and provider data pipeline, ensuring correct vector usage, indexed collections, and alignment with loaded provider records for accurate search results.
